citations.title: UBS Beats Expectations as Credit Suisse Integration Nears Completion

sentences.text: UBS Group AG combines a position as the world's only truly global wealth manager and Switzerland's leading bank, supported by strong capabilities in asset management and investment banking.

sentences.quote: Total invested assets reached a record $7.3 trillion at the end of June, supported by strong client inflows from Switzerland, EMEA and Asia-Pacific.
sentences.text: Global Wealth Management remains the main growth engine, with record total invested assets of USD 7.3 trillion at end-June 2026 on inflows from Switzerland, EMEA and Asia-Pacific.

The Credit Suisse integration is in its last stage: global client account migration was completed in March 2026, over 90% of legacy applications were out of use by the second quarter, and cumulative gross savings reached USD 12.6 billion, on track for about USD 13.5 billion by year-end.
Management targets a 2028 reported return on CET1 capital of roughly 18% and a cost/income ratio near 67%, with a 14.4% CET1 ratio in the first half of 2026.
Pending higher Swiss capital requirements are a key risk.
